notes: This fixture is what separates semantics.md §3.1 from §3.2, and it needs
both tick frames to do it.
$TICK is a breadth index, so §3.2 would blank its quotes regardless of
what the wire carried. On its own it therefore proves nothing about §3.1:
a binding that ignored wire nulls completely would still pass.
SPY is the frame that matters. It is not an index symbol, so nothing in
§3.2 applies and there is no fallback — a binding that reads the wire's
null as 0.0 produces a $0.00 quote here, which is exactly the failure
$TICK also has all five el_* quantities at 0. Breadth indices have no
traded volume at all, so this is the honest value, not a missing one.
The bar carries no bid/ask field. That is structural in this protocol,
not an artefact of the history-replay shape being recorded here — a
binding must not treat a bar as a quote source under any conditions.
